changelog:
Initial release v2.1.0

- Auto-discovers and scores free OpenRouter models (tool-aware scoring)
- Smart fallback chain with openrouter/free as first fallback
- Multi-key API rotation to multiply daily free-tier quota
- infinity-router watch — real-time log watcher with auto-rotate and gateway restart
- --validate flag to probe models before writing config
- Filters non-chat models (audio, image, video) and Gemma tool-call fakes
- Supports OpenClaw and Claude Code as config targets
